metadata.description: Curated Agent Skills for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, organized by technology stack.

plugins.name: cc-ai-dev
plugins.description: Requirement-to-code workflow skills: interview-driven specifications, traceable development plans, plan-driven implementation, root-cause bug diagnosis, and evidence-driven refactoring.

plugins.name: cc-ai-dotnet
plugins.description: .NET and C# skills: DI and configuration fundamentals, ASP.NET Core APIs, EF Core, typed client SDKs, unit tests, NuGet package management, XML documentation comments, and package/assembly inspection, with a router skill that dispatches to the right one. Most skills activate from the task description; dotnet-dev and dotnet-reviewer load on explicit invocation only (/cc-ai-dotnet:<skill> in Claude Code, /<skill> in Copilot, or the skill name in the prompt).

plugins.name: cc-ai-angular
plugins.description: Angular and TypeScript skills: DI and providers, standalone APIs and signals, components, routing and forms, state design, RxJS, publishable libraries and typed API clients, unit tests, npm package management, and TSDoc comments, with a router skill that dispatches to the right one. Most skills activate from the task description; angular-reviewer loads on explicit invocation only (/cc-ai-angular:<skill> in Claude Code, /<skill> in Copilot, or the skill name in the prompt).
